result.keyword: I slipped and fell in a shopping centre in Canberra. Which public liability lawyers are best?
result.markdown:
If you have slipped and fallen in a shopping centre in Canberra, you will want to look for personal injury or public liability law firms that operate locally in the ACT.[lawpartners.com.au](https://lawpartners.com.au/offices/personal-injury-lawyers-canberra#:~:text=If%20you've%20been%20injured%20in%20a%20public,TPD%20Lawyers.%20We'll%20get%20you%20more%20compensation.) These claims generally fall under public liability law, where you must prove that the shopping centre or the occupier breached their duty of care.

Several reputable law firms handle slip-and-fall and public liability claims in Canberra:

### Prominent Public Liability Lawyers in Canberra

* **Blumers Personal Injury Lawyers:** A well-known local firm with extensive experience specifically handling slip-and-fall accidents and public liability claims in the ACT.[www.blumers.com.au](https://www.blumers.com.au/canberra/slip-and-fall-lawyers/#:~:text=Every%20case%20is%20different%2C%20which%20is%20why,Do%20After%20A%20Slip%20%26%20Fall%20Accident.)
* **Law Partners:** A major specialist personal injury firm with a dedicated office in Canberra (NewActon) that handles public liability and slip-and-fall cases.[lawpartners.com.au](https://lawpartners.com.au/offices/personal-injury-lawyers-canberra#:~:text=If%20you've%20been%20injured%20in%20a%20public,TPD%20Lawyers.%20We'll%20get%20you%20more%20compensation.)
* **Slater and Gordon Lawyers:** A national firm with a strong local team in Canberra CBD that regularly handles shopping centre and supermarket slip-and-fall claims.[www.slatergordon.com.au](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/personal-injury/public-liability/public-liability-lawyers-in-canberra#:~:text=Our%20Canberra%20team%20are%20experienced%20and%20dedicated,a%20footpath%2C%20bike%20path%20or%20public%20park.)
* **Maliganis Edwards Johnson (MEJ):** A long-standing Canberra-based personal injury firm with deep expertise in public liability and accident claims dating back decades.[mej.com.au](https://mej.com.au/services/public-liability/)
* **GMP Law (Gerard Malouf & Partners) & Gajic Lawyers:** Other established compensation firms offering representation for personal injury and public liability matters in the ACT region.

---

### Key Things to Look For & Consider

1.  **No Win, No Fee Arrangements:** Most reputable personal injury lawyers in Canberra operate on a **"No Win, No Fee"** basis (though you should always check the fine print regarding out-of-pocket or disbursement costs, like medical reports).[www.blumers.com.au](https://www.blumers.com.au/canberra/slip-and-fall-lawyers/#:~:text=Our%20reputation%20as%20a%20dedicated%20slip%20and,we%20take%20time%20to%20understand%20your%20needs.)
2.  **Accredited Specialists:** Look for lawyers who are Law Society Accredited Specialists in Personal Injury Law, as this indicates a high level of certified expertise in handling complex negligence claims.
3.  **Initial Free Consultation:** Almost all of these firms offer a free, no-obligation initial assessment to review the facts of your fall and advise whether you have strong prospects of success.[www.slatergordon.com.au](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/personal-injury/public-liability/public-liability-lawyers-in-canberra#:~:text=Obligation%20free%20initial%20appointment.%20We%20offer%20a,you.%20Check%20your%20claim%20online%20for%20free.)

### Immediate Steps to Protect Your Claim

* **Report the Incident:** Ensure the shopping centre management or security has an official written incident report on file.
* **Preserve Evidence:** Take photos of the hazard (e.g., liquid spill, broken tile, lack of warning signs) and keep the shoes and clothing you were wearing.
* **Seek Medical Attention:** Visit a doctor promptly to document your injuries and get appropriate treatment—this is critical medical evidence for a compensation claim.
